test: state-dependent noise on sci-Plex single cells, against counting statistics
log: LOOP 246 -- STATE-DEPENDENT NOISE, AGAINST THE COUNTING STATISTICS THAT GIVE IT FOR FREE
In count data Var = mu holds for a Poisson variable before any biology, so 'noise
depends on state' is true by construction of the measurement. Every gate here is
about the OVERDISPERSION phi in Var = mu + phi*mu^2 -- the part counting cannot
produce -- and never about Var itself.
M is not estimated here: memory needs a timecourse and sci-Plex is one timepoint.
The dexamethasone WITHDRAWAL series is the instrument for it, and is the next loop.
excluded 529 cells labelled 'control' -- loop 244 established they
are 100 uM vorinostat from one well (top_oligo SAHA_100_E09)
23,733 cells x 14,672 genes detected in 300+ cells

V1 HOW MUCH OF THE VARIANCE IS COUNTING, AND HOW MUCH IS LEFT?
286,619 (gene, condition) cells with mean >= 0.05 and phi estimable
median Poisson share of the total variance: 84.6%
median overdispersion phi: 0.7891   strictly positive in 225,024

V2 PASS -- state predicts the overdispersion at 0.5884
V3 SAME GENE, SAME MEAN, DIFFERENT CONDITION -- DIFFERENT NOISE?
the proposal's actual content: Sigma varies with the CONDITION, not just the gene.
|log phi ratio| across conditions at matched mean (within 10%): 0.6011  (n=678,526)
the same statistic from splitting ONE condition's cells in half: 0.6767  (n=164,734)
difference -0.0756  (-30.2 se)
V3 FAIL -- -0.0756 (-30.2 se); the apparent condition dependence is within what splitting one condition already gives
V4 IS THERE A JUMP COMPONENT BEYOND A CONTINUOUS MODEL?
bursting predicts the observed far tail to EXCEED a negative binomial with the same
mean and dispersion. The sign is stated before the number.
29,167 well-measured (gene, condition) cells; observed 99th percentile exceeds the
negative binomial's in 26.5%, median relative excess +0.0000
V4 FAIL -- 26% exceed (bar 60%), median excess +0.000
V5 CONTROL: CELLS REASSIGNED TO THE WRONG CONDITIONS
cell-to-condition labels permuted: r = 0.5526 against a real 0.5884 (94%)
V5 FAIL -- 94% survives; V2 is reading the gene, not the condition
V6 WHAT THIS CANNOT SHOW
One cell line, one timepoint, four compounds; M is not estimated at all.
Overdispersion is not bursting. Doublets, ambient RNA, cell-cycle phase and
unmodelled substructure all inflate phi and none of them is Sigma in the intended
sense. V3 controls for the gene and the mean, not for cell-cycle composition.
Method-of-moments phi is biased at low mean, hence the stated mean floor.
A jump process is ONE explanation of a heavy tail. Zero-inflation and a two-state
mixture produce the same V4 signature and this loop cannot separate them.
